Track fast-moving news topics with dedicated agents
The author runs separate agents to keep up with news on infosec and AI, proof software like Lean, world power shifts, AI generally, and agent harnesses.
·
Nov 15, 2026
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
For a month or two, the author has used agents to keep up with fast-moving news. Each agent covers its own topic: infosec and AI, practical uses of proof software like Lean, changes in world power dynamics, AI generally, and changes in agent harnesses. The post doesn't describe the tooling, the sources the agents read, or how the author reviews their output.
How it went
The author says they have used these agents more and more over that period. The post is a short note and gives no results, numbers, or limitations.
Try it yourself
with
OpenClaw
Copy prompt
Act as my standing news tracker for [topic, e.g. infosec, AI agents, or formal proof tools]. Every [morning/week], check [sources, e.g. specific blogs, feeds, X accounts, forums] and send me a digest of the 5 most important developments with one-line explanations and links. Skip anything repetitive, and ask me before sending messages to anyone other than me.
